notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.01 | Dec 11th 2018
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes: 1.01 | Dec 11th 2018[/b]
====================

In this patch, some minor issues found in the release version have been addressed:

BUG FIXES
[list]
[*] Issue: The player cannot get a required object “blue emblem” – fixed
[*] Issue: The game shows a console window when closing – fixed
[*] Issue: Missing string in minigame – fixed
[*] Issue: The last puzzle does not show a proper description – fixed
[/list]
